category.description: Name of the category, without the namespace prefix.

size.description: Number of members of the category. Only present if requested with the size prop.

pages.description: Number of members that are neither subcategories nor files. Only present if requested with the size prop.

files.description: Number of members that are files. Only present if requested with the size prop.

subcats.description: Number of members that are subcategories. Only present if requested with the size prop.

hidden.description: Whether the category is hidden. Only present if requested with the hidden prop.
